name: News & Blog Designer Pack < 3.4.2 - Remote Code Execution
author: iamnoooob,rootxharsh,pdresearch
description: News & Blog Designer Pack contains a local file inclusion vulnerability via user controlled $design variable extracted by POST parameter 'shrt_param' leading to Remote Code Execution via pearcmd.php. The vulnerability occurs within bdp_get_more_post function inside file bdp-ajax-functions.php.
